methods.name: WALL-OSS 1.0 Lite
methods.protocol: RoboDojo leaderboard, seeds 0–2, 50 episodes per task and seed, with 25 standard and 25 random for Generalization.

methods.name: GPT Direct
methods.protocol: RoboProbe L3 Inspect EEF, GPT-6 Astra. Official 2,100-episode evaluation, 50 episodes per task.

methods.name: HexaShell (no skills)
methods.protocol: HexaShell-Universal, GPT-6 Astra. Seeds 0–2, layouts 10–19, 30 episodes per task. Table 10 reports task-family totals. Open uses no task-specific skills in either setting.

methods.name: PyRUA-Lean (no RSI)
methods.protocol: Official evaluation of the base adapter, seed 3, 50 episodes per task. Static Python runtime with no RSI.

methods.name: JustRUA
methods.protocol: Final coordinate-solving configuration at medium effort on the authors’ 111 fixed episodes, seed 0. 23 tasks have four layouts and 19 tasks have one.

methods.name: HexaShell (with skills)
methods.protocol: HexaShell-Universal, GPT-6 Astra. Seeds 0–2, layouts 10–19, 30 episodes per task. Table 10 reports task-family totals. Open uses no task-specific skills in either setting.

methods.name: π0.5
methods.protocol: RoboDojo’s π0.5 vision–language–action policy entry. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: DM0.5
methods.protocol: Dexmal’s learned vision–language–action policy. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: InternW0-Δ
methods.protocol: Shanghai AI Lab’s world action model. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: Xiaomi-Robotics-1
methods.protocol: Xiaomi’s learned vision–language–action policy. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: Awomo-0.5
methods.protocol: Image-based Awomo-0.5I world action model. The authors identify it as the model corresponding to the 29.6% benchmark entry. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: GO-3 Nano Preview
methods.protocol: Agent + WAM submission. Its agent chooses a complete manipulation program by task identity; the benchmark’s audit distinguishes this entry from the standalone WAM. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: Q0-Preview
methods.protocol: Qoo Tech’s agent calculates world-frame spatial targets. The benchmark identifies additional evaluation conditions in its task reference. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: SenseNova-RoboRSI
methods.protocol: Agent + VLA. A recursive development loop improves the harness; evaluation can retrieve task-indexed experience, including saved programs and examples. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: PhysicalRSI
methods.protocol: Agent + VLA. The recursive skill-development pipeline evaluates and retains candidate programs. The submitted v4 release selects frozen task-specific programs. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: WorldScape-R²SI
methods.protocol: Agent + WAM. An outer loop revises, tests and retains reusable skills and memory. The authors describe the skill library as shared across tasks. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: EmbodiedEvo
methods.protocol: A coding agent develops reusable skills and lessons over repeated practice, then freezes them for evaluation. The benchmark identifies task-specific skill and lesson files. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: HexaShell-Preview (TaskTools)
methods.protocol: The TaskTools predecessor to HexaShell-Universal. An optimizer developed task-specific control tools over 769 rounds before evaluation. Official RoboDojo simulation leaderboard.

methods.name: Agent-as-Policy (seed 0)
methods.protocol: Authors’ seed-0 release, GPT-6 Astra high, 2,100 episodes. The selected task notes and hints include procedural guidance. The leaderboard aggregate for a different run is 54.88%.
